node.title: The F2 terminal pinned to the MASS form with its proved constraints: THEOREM Z-FLOOR (pointwise first-moment floor Z >= 2^m/p^{dim L}, one Cauchy-Schwarz from a banked identity, tight in 2x), THEOREM Z-1 (the DLI distance law transports — min ternary weight >= 2R+1, blind-convergent with the adversary's D1, shift-0 scope), THEOREM Z-2 (l1 extension gifted back to DLI), THEOREM Z-NOGO (distance+counting needs p <= 8 and can NEVER close the terminal); at k = e the floor sits on a 46-bit knife edge (one Lambda condition = 64 bits; the two t-readings straddle zero, exact-zero form dies where it fires); the open terminal = Z_1 <= 2^{o(m)} with NO named route (route (b) sizing refuted round 19; the tail-count criterion is the open form)
node.statement: On the admissible F2 object ([S,S-R,R+1]_p negacyclic GRS on the half-system, S = 2^40/e, R/S = 1/log2 p, Z(L) = Z_1^C, C <= 4): THEOREM Z-FLOOR: Z(L) >= 2^m/p^{dim L} POINTWISE for every subspace (Cauchy-Schwarz on the banked collision identity dli_c1_l1_block_owner_ledger:15,18; tight within 2x of the ensemble mean; 696 configs 0 violations). THEOREM Z-1: char > w holds on every admissible row (p > m by the e_p case split; the tower verdict reversed), so min ternary weight >= 2R+1 = 8,589,934,681 — blind-convergent with o1_generating_adversary THEOREM D1; shift-0 windows only (43 shifted counterexamples; legitimate because the official window starts at 1). THEOREM Z-2: the DLI exclusion holds for all integer coefficients at l1 weight ({+1,-1} unnecessary). THEOREM Z-NOGO: saturation pins R/S = 1/log2 p, so the whole distance+counting family (39.2x -> 28.3x -> 21.3x ladder) needs p <= 8 vs admissible log2 p >= 39 — structurally incapable of closing the terminal. KNIFE EDGE at k = e: the floor is silent by 46.02 bits of 2.75e11 under R = ceil(t/2) and FIRES (+17.98 bits) under the exact-balance reading — there ternary kernel vectors provably exist (Z_1 >= 2^{17.98}), the EXACT-ZERO form dies, the MASS form survives (Z = 2^{o(n)}); the reading belongs to the maintainer stack. CATCH-Z1: mass form != exact-zero form (differ by log2 3 per vector) — the terminal of record is the MASS form: prove Z_1 <= 2^{o(m)} at k = e. Route (b) sizing REFUTED (round-19: degree factor restored, Weil vacuous by 26.000 bits; the AM-GM+Z-2 substitute THEOREM 7 gives unconditional Z_1 <= 2^{0.8908 S} but closes only at p <= 8.30 = Z-NOGO threshold; NO NAMED ROUTE REMAINS — open = the tail-count criterion; the Prop-10 lead RETIRED — round-20 CATCH-T1: it telescopes to the elementary cost form; the open form of record is the NORMALIZED tail criterion Pr[P >= 2^{cS}] <= 2^{-cS+o(S)} with binding layer c* = 1/ln2 - 1 = 0.4427 at ZERO flat-model margin, the tail being a small-values/box count of the MDS value code; both standard supplies killed (p <= 8.30 / no p); the deficit is R-LOCALITY, factor 8.60; one endpoint layer proved); (a) dead quantified (corrected constant per round-19 CATCH-T3: yields w >= p^{4R/n} = 4.0000, the sharp ceiling being w^{n/4} not w^{n/2}; dead either way); (c) localises only. Calibration at or below random median on all valid miniatures (2-power 2N only, CATCH-Z6 grid rule); no toy is evidence at the official row. NOT claimed: the open mass bound; the t-reading; a shifted law. Provenance: notes/pilots_20260806/z1_ternary_mass (81/81), coordinator-replayed.
